summary: Owens Corning filed an 8-K on April 30, 2026, disclosing the completion of the sale of substantially all of its global glass reinforcements business to affiliates of the Praana Group (Triumph Composites Private Limited and 3B Lux S.r.l.). The enterprise value was revised downward from $755 million to $645 million via an amendment on April 14, 2026. Net after-tax cash proceeds are expected to be approximately $280 million. The company intends to use proceeds for organic growth and shareholder returns. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The transaction closed on April 30, 2026. Watch for execution of capital allocation plans and potential reinvestment or buyback announcements.
